items.rationale: The selected glazing cover includes drilling needed to refit the hardware under §§1.3 and 2.7.2. The estimate is €20 gross for one hole.

items.description: Fit replacement glass into the frame
items.rationale: Section 2.7.2 covers fitting the replacement pane into the existing frame. The estimate is €48 gross for fitting one pane, excluding the separately billed drilling and travel.
Section 2.7.2 covers the custom-cut cabinet pane, and §7.1.10 limits payment to the pre-loss specification. The estimate is €80 gross for one like-for-like pane.
Sections 2.7.2 and 7.1.12 cover one attendance at which the contractor performed insured glazing work. The estimate is €25 gross for that visit, payable without apportionment.
